profile.name: Muhammad Daffa' Ayyasy
profile.headline: Fresh Graduate Software Engineer
profile.summary: Fresh Graduate Software Engineer with hands-on experience building backend features for a Laravel-based project management system and a Node.js health prediction application. Skilled in designing RESTful APIs, integrating cloud services, and applying Repository and Service Layer patterns to keep backend code maintainable. Currently completing a Bachelor's degree in Informatics, with an academic focus on NLP model fine-tuning and a strong interest in backend engineering, cloud platforms, and applied AI.
profile.aboutDetail: I enjoy turning clear requirements into reliable software. My experience spans Laravel, React, Node.js, Google Cloud, and machine learning integrations, with a practical focus on clean code, structured collaboration, and solutions that are easy to maintain.

experience.description: Built worker-management capabilities for a modular Laravel project-management system with a React and Inertia.js frontend.
details: Developed CRUD workflows, worker-to-project assignments, and project-specific worker roles and positions.
Implemented worker attendance connected to project-detail pages, including worker profile photo upload and display.
Applied Repository Pattern, Service Layer, and Form Request validation to separate business logic and input validation.
Collaborated through Git using member-based branching, code review, and merge workflows.

experience.company: Bangkit Academy led by Google, Tokopedia, Gojek & Traveloka
experience.description: Contributed to the backend of a health-prediction application in a cross-functional team spanning backend, machine learning, and mobile development.
details: Built RESTful registration and login APIs with bcrypt-based password protection.
Integrated TensorFlow.js model inference into the health-prediction API and stored prediction history in Google Cloud Firestore.
Containerized and deployed the backend service with Docker on Google Cloud Platform.
Completed structured learning in Web Basics, JavaScript Basics, Back-End Basics, and Cloud Engineering.

projects.title: Abstractive Film Review Summarization
projects.description: Built a reproducible NLP experimentation pipeline for film-review summarization: review preprocessing, five-review block construction, sentiment-balanced train/validation/test splits, fine-tuning T5-Base, and a BART-Base baseline. Hyperparameters are tuned with Optuna TPE and outputs are evaluated with ROUGE and METEOR.
details: Designed preprocessing and dataset-validation scripts that group five reviews, enforce helpfulness criteria, and produce balanced sentiment splits.
Implemented fine-tuning experiments for google-t5/t5-base and a facebook/bart-base baseline across combined and sentiment-separated scenarios.
Tuned hyperparameters with Optuna TPE and evaluated generated summaries using ROUGE and METEOR metrics.

projects.title: BookIt Event Ticketing Platform
projects.description: Contributed to a full-stack event ticketing platform with customer and organizer flows: authentication, event discovery and search, event and ticket-type management, image upload, transactional ticket ordering, Midtrans payment integration, QR ticket generation and verification, and organizer reports.
details: Implemented organizer dashboard, reporting-page, sidebar-navigation, and customer-account flow updates across the Next.js application.
Worked across API routes for authentication, events, orders, ticket verification, profiles, and uploads using Prisma and PostgreSQL.
Contributed to ticketing flows involving transactional orders, Midtrans payments, QR tickets, and Docker configuration.

projects.title: Teman Klinik Medicine Recommendation System
projects.description: Enhanced a Flask medicine-recommendation application backed by Apache Jena Fuseki and SPARQL. The system matches symptoms to medicines, filters recommendations by patient conditions and allergies, offers herbal alternatives, and warns users about high-urgency symptoms through an ontology-based knowledge graph.
details: Refined the Flask interface and input flow for selecting symptoms, patient conditions, and active-ingredient allergies.
Updated the RDF/OWL knowledge graph data and ontology relationships used by the medicine-recommendation queries.
Adjusted the SPARQL-backed recommendation flow to support contraindication filtering, herbal alternatives, and high-urgency warnings.

profile.name: Muhammad Daffa' Ayyasy

profile.summary: Fresh Graduate Software Engineer dengan pengalaman langsung membangun fitur back-end untuk sistem manajemen proyek berbasis Laravel dan aplikasi prediksi kesehatan berbasis Node.js. Terampil merancang RESTful API, mengintegrasikan layanan cloud, serta menerapkan Repository Pattern dan Service Layer agar kode back-end tetap terstruktur dan mudah dipelihara. Sedang menyelesaikan pendidikan S1 Informatika dengan fokus akademik pada fine-tuning model NLP dan ketertarikan kuat pada back-end engineering, cloud, serta penerapan AI.
profile.aboutDetail: Saya senang menerjemahkan kebutuhan yang jelas menjadi perangkat lunak yang dapat diandalkan. Pengalaman saya mencakup Laravel, React, Node.js, Google Cloud, dan integrasi machine learning, dengan fokus praktis pada clean code, kolaborasi terstruktur, dan solusi yang mudah dipelihara.

experience.description: Mengembangkan fitur manajemen pekerja untuk sistem manajemen proyek modular berbasis Laravel dengan frontend React dan Inertia.js.
details: Membangun alur CRUD, penugasan pekerja ke proyek, serta pengelolaan role dan posisi pekerja pada setiap proyek.
Mengimplementasikan presensi pekerja yang terhubung dengan halaman detail proyek, termasuk unggah dan tampilan foto profil pekerja.
Menerapkan Repository Pattern, Service Layer, dan validasi Form Request untuk memisahkan logika bisnis dan validasi input.
Berkolaborasi menggunakan Git dengan branching per anggota, code review, dan alur merge.

projects.title: Peringkasan Abstraktif Ulasan Film
projects.description: Membangun pipeline eksperimen NLP yang reproducible untuk peringkasan ulasan film: preprocessing ulasan, penyusunan blok lima ulasan, pembagian data train/validation/test yang seimbang berdasarkan sentimen, fine-tuning T5-Base, dan baseline BART-Base. Hyperparameter dioptimalkan dengan Optuna TPE dan hasil dievaluasi menggunakan ROUGE serta METEOR.
details: Merancang script preprocessing dan validasi dataset untuk mengelompokkan lima ulasan, menerapkan kriteria helpfulness, dan menghasilkan split sentimen yang seimbang.
Mengimplementasikan eksperimen fine-tuning google-t5/t5-base dan baseline facebook/bart-base pada skenario gabungan serta pemisahan sentimen.
Mengoptimalkan hyperparameter dengan Optuna TPE dan mengevaluasi ringkasan menggunakan metrik ROUGE serta METEOR.

projects.title: BookIt Event Ticketing Platform
projects.description: Berkontribusi pada platform ticketing event full-stack dengan alur customer dan organizer: autentikasi, pencarian event, pengelolaan event dan tipe tiket, unggah gambar, pemesanan tiket transaksional, integrasi pembayaran Midtrans, pembuatan dan verifikasi tiket QR, serta laporan organizer.
details: Mengimplementasikan pembaruan dashboard organizer, halaman laporan, navigasi sidebar, dan alur perpindahan akun customer pada aplikasi Next.js.
Bekerja pada route API untuk autentikasi, event, order, verifikasi tiket, profil, dan upload menggunakan Prisma serta PostgreSQL.
Berkontribusi pada alur ticketing yang mencakup order transaksional, pembayaran Midtrans, tiket QR, dan konfigurasi Docker.

projects.title: Sistem Rekomendasi Obat Teman Klinik
projects.description: Mengembangkan dan menyempurnakan aplikasi rekomendasi obat berbasis Flask dengan Apache Jena Fuseki dan SPARQL. Sistem mencocokkan gejala dengan obat, menyaring rekomendasi berdasarkan kondisi pasien dan alergi, menawarkan alternatif herbal, serta memberikan peringatan untuk gejala dengan tingkat urgensi tinggi melalui knowledge graph berbasis ontologi.
details: Menyempurnakan antarmuka Flask dan alur input untuk memilih gejala, kondisi pasien, serta alergi bahan aktif.
Memperbarui data knowledge graph RDF/OWL dan relasi ontologi yang digunakan oleh query rekomendasi obat.
Menyesuaikan alur rekomendasi berbasis SPARQL untuk mendukung filter kontraindikasi, alternatif herbal, dan peringatan gejala berurgensi tinggi.
